controles.affirmation: Quatre produits AbbVie selectionnes pour des prix fixes par Medicare : Imbruvica (prix impose depuis 2026), Vraylar et Linzess (2027), Botox (2028, Parts B et D)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "In August 2023, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), through CMS, selected Imbruvica as one of 10 medicines subject to government-set prices in Medicare Part D beginning January 1, 2026, and in January 2025, selected Vraylar and Linzess as two of 15 medicines subject to government-set prices in Medicare Part D beginning January 1, 2027. In January 2026, Botox was selected as one of 15 medicines subject to government-set prices in Medicare Parts B and D beginning January 1, 2028."

controles.affirmation: La seule selection d'Imbruvica en 2023 a declenche une depreciation de 2,1 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "In the third quarter of 2023, as part of the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, the company's oncology product Imbruvica sold in the U.S. was included on the list of products subject to government-set prices by CMS... the company recorded a pre-tax impairment charge of $ 2.1 billion to cost of products sold"

controles.affirmation: Le 10-K reconnait que d'autres produits a fort CA pourront etre selectionnes, ce qui peut accelerer l'erosion des revenus avant meme l'expiration des brevets
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "It is possible that more of our products, including products that generate substantial revenues, could be selected in future years, which could, among other things, accelerate revenue erosion prior to expiration of intellectual property protections."

controles.affirmation: Accord volontaire signe avec le gouvernement americain en janvier 2026 : prix bas dans Medicaid, offres directes aux patients, 100 Mds $ d'investissements aux Etats-Unis sur dix ans, en echange d'une exemption de trois ans sur les tarifs douaniers et les futurs mandats de prix
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In January 2026, AbbVie announced a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government... AbbVie will provide low prices in Medicaid and expand affordable, direct-to-patient offerings. Additionally, AbbVie pledged $100 billion in U.S.-based research and development and capital investments, including manufacturing, over the next decade. Under this voluntary agreement, the U.S. government has agreed to provide AbbVie a three-year exemption from tariffs and future price mandates."

controles.affirmation: Brevets americains de composition de Skyrizi et Rinvoq expirant en 2033 ; accords de septembre 2025 avec les fabricants de generiques repoussant toute copie de Rinvoq comprimes a avril 2037 sous reserve d'exclusivite pediatrique
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "The United States composition of matter patents covering risankizumab and upadacitinib are expected to expire in 2033. In September 2025, AbbVie settled litigation with all generic manufacturers that filed abbreviated new drug applications with the U.S. FDA for generic versions of upadacitinib tablets. Given the settlement and license agreements, which are subject to standard acceleration provisions, assuming pediatric exclusivity is granted, no generic entry for Rinvoq tablets is expected prior to April 2037 in the United States."

controles.affirmation: Skyrizi + Rinvoq = 47,3% du CA du T2 2026 (8 030 M$ sur 16 990 M$), contre 42,3% en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : Skyrizi Total $ 5,505 (vs 4,423) ; Rinvoq Total $ 2,525 (vs 2,028) ; CA total 16,990. 10-K FY2025 : Skyrizi 17,562 + Rinvoq 8,304 sur 61,160 = 42,3%

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres negatifs de -5 935 M$ au 30 juin 2026 (deficit total -5 888) contre -3 270 M$ (deficit total -3 228) au 31 decembre 2025, deficit accumule de 17 333 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 bilan : "Accumulated deficit (17,333) / (15,493)" ; "Total stockholders' deficit (5,935) / (3,270)" ; "Total deficit (5,888) / (3,228)"

controles.affirmation: Dette de 70,8 Mds $ (62 481 long terme + 8 341 courant) pour 6 569 M$ de tresorerie, interets nets de 1 324 M$ au S1, 7 991 M$ de dette nouvelle emise
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Cash and equivalents 6,569" ; "Current portion of long-term debt 8,341" ; "Long-term debt 62,481" (total 70 822)
controles.correction_proposee: Le texte de l'ATT parle tantot de "8,0 Mds $ de dette nouvelle" tantot de "7 991 M$" : coherent, aucune correction requise.

controles.affirmation: Passif de contrepartie conditionnelle de 27 495 M$ au 30 juin 2026 contre 25 374 M$ fin 2025, charge de 3 905 M$ au S1 2026, paiements cash de 1 784 M$, paiements projetes jusqu'en 2044
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Contingent consideration 27,495 / 25,374" ; "the change in fair value reflected higher estimated Skyrizi sales" ; tableau "2026 - 2044" ; note (c) : "the projected year of payments ends in 2037 for Skyrizi and in 2044 for pipeline assets in combination with Skyrizi"
controles.correction_proposee: Precision possible : 2044 correspond aux actifs de pipeline en combinaison avec Skyrizi ; les paiements Skyrizi seuls s'arretent en 2037. Formulation actuelle acceptable mais moins precise que la source.
